category: Transformer decoder block (causal attention + LUT-FFN + residuals, composition)
edge_cases: CAUSAL mask: query i attends only to keys j<=i; row 0 is the fully-degenerate case (attends only to itself)
FFN activation is a runtime LUT (GELU-shaped), not a closed-form ReLU -- distinct mechanism from i8_transformer_encoder_block
LUT-index saturation columns: b1[0]=-4000 (always clamps to LUT index 0), b1[1]=+4000 (always clamps to LUT index 255)
FFN output saturation columns: b2[0]=-300 (sat-low -128), b2[1]=+300 (sat-high +127)
causal softmax window length varies per row i (1..S), never a fixed multiple of 128 -- exercises HVX partial-vector masking (Q6_Q_vsetq_R) at every row
FFN down-proj reduction length Dff=128 is exactly one full HVX vector -- must NOT be predicate-masked (Q6_Q_vsetq_R only encodes 0..127)
nearmiss_noncausal drops the causal mask (attends to the full sequence, encoder-style) -> INCORRECT for all rows i<S-1
poisoned output buffer; runtime exp_lut and act_lut (anti-hardcode)
name: i8_decoder_block
signal: causal transformer decoder block (masked attention + LUT-FFN + 2 residuals)
